body.purpose: Default readable UI and prose content.

shadows.name: medium-utility
shadows.purpose: Utility overlays and compact raised elements.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action button for run and submit flows.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-chartwell-blue); color: var(--surface-cloud-white); border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 16px; font: 600 16px/1.5 var(--font-inter); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2388d1; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.985); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-chartwell-blue); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Utility Button
components.description: Secondary utility action used for filters and local controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: var(--surface-cloud-white); color: var(--color-slate-text); border: 1px solid var(--color-stone-border); border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 12px; font: 500 14px/1.4 var(--font-inter); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--color-chartwell-blue); background: var(--color-sky-tint); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-chartwell-blue); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Default text field for ticker and filter inputs.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 4px; max-width: 320px; } .ds-field-label { font: 500 12px/1.5 var(--font-inter); color: var(--color-ash-gray); } .ds-input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--color-stone-border); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface-cloud-white); color: var(--color-slate-text); padding: 8px 12px; font: 400 16px/1.5 var(--font-inter); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-steel-gray); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-chartwell-blue); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: var(--color-chartwell-blue); }

components.name: Navigation Item Active
components.description: Left-rail navigation item with active and inactive states.
components.html: AnalysisHistory
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 4px; max-width: 220px; } .ds-nav-item { text-decoration: none; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 4px; font: 500 16px/1.5 var(--font-inter); color: var(--color-slate-text); background: transparent; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(59, 166, 241, 0.08); } .ds-nav-item-active { color: var(--color-chartwell-blue); background: var(--color-sky-tint); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-chartwell-blue); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Standard Card
components.description: Primary container for setup, run, and report modules.
components.html:
Run

Configure ticker, model settings, and start a new analysis run.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--surface-cloud-white); border: 1px solid var(--color-stone-border); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0px 1px 2px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); padding: 24px; display: grid; gap: 12px; max-width: 520px; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font: 600 20px/1.2 var(--font-inter); color: var(--color-slate-text); } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font: 400 16px/1.5 var(--font-inter); color: var(--color-ash-gray); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Compact selectable chip used in source and status filtering.
components.css: .ds-chip { border: 1px solid var(--color-stone-border); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--surface-cloud-white); color: var(--color-slate-text); padding: 6px 12px; font: 500 12px/1.5 var(--font-inter); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--color-chartwell-blue); } .ds-chip-active { border-color: var(--color-chartwell-blue); background: var(--color-sky-tint); color: var(--color-chartwell-blue); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-chartwell-blue); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
This system is an analyst companion, approachable and professional, built to keep users oriented through a dense decision workflow. The interface should always answer three questions quickly: what state the system is in, what evidence is available, and what action is next.

Visual language prioritizes stable structure over decorative novelty. Surfaces stay neutral and readable, accents are reserved for action and status, and interaction patterns repeat consistently across dashboard, history, screener, and system pages.

The system explicitly rejects Generic glossy SaaS marketing aesthetics, Neon trading-terminal visuals, Dense enterprise backoffice complexity, and Playful consumer-app styling.
keyCharacteristics: Stable app shell with predictable navigation and page rhythm.
Neutral-first surfaces with one signal accent for actions and active states.
Dense but readable information layout, with progressive disclosure for advanced controls.
Motion used for feedback and transitions, not choreography.

rules.name: The Single Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue is the only saturated accent in standard screens. If another saturated color appears, it must represent state semantics such as error or success, not decoration.

rules.name: The Scan-First Rule
rules.body: Typography must support scanning before reading. If body text and metadata compete for attention, reduce metadata contrast first.

rules.name: The Tonal First Rule
rules.body: Choose background and border contrast before adding shadow. If depth still feels ambiguous after tonal correction, then add the lightest shadow that solves it.

dos: Do keep primary pages in neutral surfaces (#fafaf9, #ffffff) with Signal Blue (#3ba6f1) reserved for action and state.
Do maintain consistent control geometry (4px, 10px, 16px, 9999px) instead of per-screen custom radii.
Do use progressive disclosure for advanced controls, keep essentials visible first.
Do keep run status, progress, and failure context visible near the active workflow.
donts: Don't use Generic glossy SaaS marketing aesthetics that prioritize decoration over utility.
Don't use Neon trading-terminal visuals that increase urgency and fatigue.
Don't use Dense enterprise backoffice complexity with overloaded controls and jargon-heavy labels.
Don't use Playful consumer-app styling that weakens financial-research credibility.
Don't use gradient text, heavy glassmorphism, or side-stripe accent borders as decorative shortcuts.
